about: Step 14 text fixes from the Oct 31 2026 audit (sow/audit_2026-10-31/CHANGE_LOG.md). Each value replaces the field; a key starting with + appends a sentence. Facts checked on Experience League on Oct 31 2026: Impact Measurement Engine, Optimize at Edge onboarding and CDN guides, Enrich Product Detail Pages, Brand Concierge live chat and meeting booking, Brand Concierge pre-go-live checklist, Brand Visibility and CJA integration and dataset reference, Coworker overview.

L01.basis: One strategy package for one brand and domain; the prompts and markets set its planning band.
L01.scope: Run two discovery workshops and curate 200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages (200 is the usual start), covering agreed customer intents, three competitors and five business measures. Adjust the prompt count to the customer's license.

L02.basis: One baseline package for one workspace and domain, with up to 10 pilot users; the prompts and markets set its planning band.
L02.scope: Configure the agreed monitoring portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages), validate access for up to 10 pilot users, confirm the delivery-network setup and get CDN log forwarding enabled with the customer's IT team, and record one baseline for the agreed prompts and three competitors.

L03.basis: One supported optimization route and one deployment of 20 to 50 eligible URLs.
L03.scope: Configure one supported Brand Visibility optimization route; deploy approved changes for one supported opportunity type (such as Recover Content Visibility, Add Table of Contents or Add LLM-friendly Summaries) to 20 to 50 URLs chosen with the High Potential URLs filter, in one deployment; verify rollback; keep those pages unchanged during the measurement period; and run two operator sessions. Review the Impact Measurement Engine's analysis with the customer if Adobe generates one.
L03.deliverable: Validated deployment pilot, release and rollback checklist, operator handover, and the Impact Measurement Engine's impact analysis when Adobe generates one for the deployment.
L03.acceptance: Approved pilot changes deploy successfully, rollback is verified and the customer accepts release ownership. The impact analysis is reviewed when available; it is not an acceptance condition, because Adobe generates it only for eligible deployments and measures only pages with enough data, using a representative subset of the URLs.
L03.assumptions: The customer has an eligible deployment route (Optimize at Edge routing on the outer CDN: already in place, applied by the customer's CDN team, or covered by CDN readiness and routing in the Commerce play), access, capacity and approved changes. Trial workspaces have tighter deployment limits (Adobe's pages give 10 pages, or 50 URLs for trials from April 1, 2026), so the paid offer is assumed. Adobe lists edge auto-optimization as Early Access for select opportunities, so the opportunity type is confirmed for the client. Adobe generates an impact analysis only for eligible deployments: a supported opportunity type and at least 20 URLs from the High Potential URLs filter in a single deployment. Recover Content Visibility results typically take about two weeks. This package is selected only when automated deployment is required.

A01.scope: Turn Brand Visibility findings and the customer's search strategy into the site plan and information architecture; design and build the block library and page templates on Edge Delivery; set up authoring, the CDN route (Adobe's managed CDN or the customer's own, confirmed in discovery) and the agreed integrations; build the agreed pages; and set up Brand Visibility's Optimize at Edge routing on that CDN.
A01.deliverable: A working Edge Delivery site with templates and blocks, configured authoring, CDN route and integrations, Brand Visibility's edge routing verified, and a build record.
A01.+assumptions: Optimize at Edge serves AI agents an optimized copy at the CDN without changing the pages people see; lasting fixes go into the source content through the authoring and publishing workflow. Routing is self-serve in Brand Visibility only on AEM as a Cloud Service's managed Fastly CDN; on any other CDN the CDN team adds the rules.

F02.scope: Set up the Brand Concierge experience for the agreed banking or insurance products: connect and curate the approved content sources, design the conversations and guardrails for the agreed questions, configure the brand voice and the required disclosures, set up one supported handoff to the customer-designated team, build the golden-answer test set and the refusal and escalation scenarios with the customer's reviewers, complete Adobe's pre-go-live checks, and launch on the agreed pages in stages.
F02.deliverable: A live Brand Concierge experience on the agreed pages; the source, guardrail and disclosure configuration; the golden-answer test set and results; the refusal and escalation scenarios; the completed pre-go-live checklist; and the launch and rollout record.
F02.acceptance: Customer reviewers approve the sampled answers, disclosures and the handoff; the golden-answer tests and the refusal and escalation scenarios pass; stakeholders sign off the pre-go-live checks; and the experience is live on the agreed pages, rolled out in the agreed stages.
F02.assumptions: The customer has licensed Brand Concierge and supplies the approved content, current product facts, reviewers and the handoff destination; compliance decisions stay with the customer. The documented handoff is live chat or meeting booking through Adobe Marketo Qualifier (formerly Sales Qualifier), which needs representatives with a connected calendar or set chat availability; a handoff to another chat or contact-center platform is not a documented route and is confirmed with Adobe first. Live chat conversations are kept for 30 days, so the customer confirms its own record-keeping needs. The baseline is the anonymous, public-information experience; profile-based answers are not assumed. Hours scale with the number of products, sources, journeys and test conversations.

C02.scope: Connect the agreed Commerce catalog, map up to 10 product attributes, and validate enrichment for up to 25 product-detail pages. The enrichment is served to AI agents at the edge; the catalog records and the page shoppers see stay unchanged.
C02.assumptions: The Commerce catalog connection and Optimize at Edge routing are ready, or CDN readiness and routing is selected. The page and attribute counts are a partner pilot boundary, not an Adobe limit. Adobe's Impact Measurement Engine does not list product-page enrichment among its supported opportunities, so the pilot's results are measured with the agreed analytics. Pilot pages already tested elsewhere are excluded from this unit.

C07.name: CDN readiness and routing where required
C07.basis: One Adobe Commerce store and its outer CDN: Optimize at Edge routing for AI agents, verified on one page.
C07.scope: Confirm how the store serves pages to AI agents and search engines and which CDN sits closest to visitors, since routing goes on that outer CDN. Prepare and test the Optimize at Edge routing rules for that CDN (Adobe's guides cover Fastly, Akamai, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Azure Front Door and Apache) and have the customer's CDN team, or the partner with delegated access, apply them in the agreed change window; allow Adobe's edge-optimization user agent through robots.txt and any firewall or bot-manager rules, keep the cache for AI agents separate, test failover to the origin and rollback, and verify one page ahead of the deployment pilot.
C07.deliverable: The documented CDN topology and routing, the configured rules, the one-page verification, the rollback steps and the handoff to the deployment pilot.
C07.acceptance: An approved optimization reaches AI agents through the customer's outer CDN on the verification page, people and search bots still get the origin page, rollback is tested, and the customer's hosting owner accepts the configuration.
C07.assumptions: The CDN topology, the routing owner and a change window are confirmed in week one: the partner prepares and tests the rules, the customer's CDN team (or the partner, with delegated access) applies them, and the hosting owner approves. Adobe documents self-serve routing only for AEM as a Cloud Service sites on Adobe's managed Fastly CDN; every other setup, including the Fastly service on Adobe Commerce on cloud infrastructure and any customer CDN, needs routing rules on the outer CDN. When an existing setup is confirmed ready, the Small band covers confirming and verifying it.

C04.basis: One financial-services Concierge experience (built in this engagement or already live), 20 priority discovery questions, 10 conversation paths and one supported human handoff.
C04.scope: Map 20 banking or insurance discovery questions from the ABV program to customer-approved Concierge sources. Validate 10 conversation paths against approved product facts, rates, fees and disclosures, and test one supported handoff to the customer-designated team.
C04.acceptance: Customer-designated reviewers approve the source map and sampled answer checks. The agreed handoff works in the customer's environment, and open exceptions are recorded with owners before customer approval.
C04.assumptions: The Concierge experience (built in Implement Brand Concierge, or already live and healthy), the financial-services use case and the handoff route are approved and available. The customer supplies current authoritative content, source owners, reviewers and applicable review criteria. ABV findings are carried to Concierge through a partner-managed question-to-approved-source workflow; no native connector is assumed. The customer confirms the prerequisites and availability of the selected handoff integration.
C04.exclusions: Brand Concierge implementation (a separate service), a native ABV-Concierge connector, a new handoff platform, ongoing content production, legal advice and automated compliance certification.

O01.basis: One monthly review package for one brand and domain; the prompts and markets set its planning band.
O01.scope: Maintain the prompt portfolio (200 to 1,000 prompts in up to three markets or languages) and three competitors; review up to five prompt changes, read the Impact Measurement Engine's results when a deployment pilot is in scope, prioritize up to 10 actions, and hold one customer review using five business measures.
O01.deliverable: Prompt change log (a stable trend cohort kept apart from new discovery prompts, with market, language, engine and configuration changes recorded), visibility and citation trends reported as movement against named peers with sampling limits noted, a prioritized optimization backlog and an outcome report.
O01.+acceptance: It keeps visibility, AI-agent activity and AI-referred visits and conversions as separate measures and claims business impact only from a tested comparison.

O04.scope: Prioritize 10 relevant publications, review roundups, directories or other independent sources, chosen from those AI answers cite for the agreed prompts; create two approved evidence-based pitch assets and complete up to 10 customer-authorized outreach actions or sourced correction requests, including Wikipedia where appropriate (Wikipedia changes are proposed on the article's talk page with the paid-contribution disclosure Wikipedia requires; the partner does not edit articles about the client directly). For financial services, use customer-approved claims and trusted financial outlets.
O04.assumptions: Credible customer evidence and explicit outreach authorization are available. An existing source-priority list and the monthly performance review are reused when included; research and reporting already in another selected service are not repeated here. Customer-designated financial-services reviewers approve applicable claims. Publishers and community editors retain all editorial decisions. The action counts are a capacity limit, not an outcome.
O04.exclusions: Paid media, guaranteed placements or citations, fabricated endorsements, undisclosed paid editing, owned-site content production, Reddit/community participation and YouTube execution scoped in separate selected services.

O06.scope: Plan, configure and analyze one agreed optimization test or comparison using existing measurement tools, with matched untreated pages or a staged comparison where feasible; record concurrent changes such as AI model updates, campaigns and competitor moves; and deliver one results readout.
O06.sourceTitle: Experience League: Impact Measurement Engine (Adobe's own method and limits)
O06.+assumptions: This is a partner test method; Adobe's Impact Measurement Engine covers only eligible edge deployments.

O08.scope: Align two existing videos that appear in the AI answers to the tracked prompts with priority customer questions and approved facts (Brand Visibility's cited-video analysis applies only when those answers cite YouTube videos). Improve titles, descriptions, available chapter markers, captions and relevant destination links; publish the approved updates in the customer's existing YouTube channel. If no videos are cited in a month, the partner and customer agree whether the hours go to other off-site work or are not billed.
O08.assumptions: The customer owns the videos, provides channel access and supplies approved source facts and reviewers. Existing footage can answer the agreed questions without re-recording. The shared opportunity research and monthly report are reused when included. Financial-services content follows the customer's designated review. The channel supports the agreed caption and chapter features. The video count is a capacity limit, not an outcome.

CW06.scope: Run the adoption program after the pilot: use cases, one enablement session a month, a prompt library and one usage review; make up to two minor approved Skill updates and maintain the prioritized improvement backlog.
CW06.+assumptions: Review usage after three months and reset the band to the actual update volume and value.
CW06.exclusions: New workflows, connector or platform builds, major data remediation, 24/7 support and duplicate performance reporting already in another selected service.

CW-FSI.+assumptions: These Skills are partner-built and need their own evaluation; they help reviewers and don't replace the customer's review. Adobe's Coworker in Workfront page says Coworker is not currently available to organizations in health care, finance or some other industries, so confirm eligibility with Adobe before proposing this to a bank or insurer.

C06.assumptions: The customer licenses Real-Time Customer Profile or another supported destination, and channel owners take part. Audiences come from AI-referred visitors in the customer's existing web data, found with a derived field on AI referring domains; the Brand Visibility dataset holds only aggregate AI-agent activity by URL and host, with no personal identifiers, and is not needed for these audiences.

CW02.+assumptions: The work covers Coworker Chat in the customer's licensed, eligible Adobe applications; Coworker for teams, a separate standalone application, is out of scope.

C01.scope: Configure the supported ABV bot-data connection and map URLs and hosts; identify AI-referred visits in the existing CJA web data with a derived field on AI referring domains; and align observed AI-referral and conversion measures with existing CJA data.
C01.assumptions: The integration is available (Adobe Analytics can feed Brand Visibility's referral reporting, but the AI-agent dataset reaches CJA only), the customer is on the paid Brand Visibility offer (trial workspaces cannot connect), the CJA integration is enabled for the organization, and CDN log forwarding is live, since the connection reads the CDN log summaries. Customer application owners provide access and approve metric definitions.
C01.deliverable: Validated connection, metric definitions and an initial report of AI-agent activity and AI-referred visits and conversions, kept as separate measures.

C03.sourceTitle: Experience League: Brand Visibility, Optimize at Edge
C03.+assumptions: This is a partner-designed workflow: Adobe documents no direct publishing link from Brand Visibility into AEM, so its findings reach AEM through the customer's authoring and approval process.

CW-CJA.+assumptions: Adobe ships executive-summary and KPI-digest skills; these Skills cover the client's agreed AI-channel measures that those don't. Coworker supports the B2C edition of CJA; the B2B edition is listed as coming soon.

CW-AEM.+assumptions: Adobe ships page-update, bulk-update and brand-compliance skills; these Skills cover only the client-specific steps those don't. Coworker's AEM work needs AEM agent access, confirmed with the customer's Adobe CSM or TAM.

CW01.+assumptions: Adobe says Coworker is not currently available to organizations in health care, finance or some other industries; confirm eligibility with Adobe first.

CW00.+assumptions: Adobe says Coworker is not currently available to organizations in health care, finance or some other industries; confirm eligibility with Adobe first.
CW00.exclusions: Skill development, optional connections, recurring support and Adobe-owned provisioning. The separate discovery, context and training packages are not also charged for this scope.

O07.scope: Review the threads that AI answers cite for the agreed prompts, and each community's participation rules, in up to three Reddit or other communities. Prepare up to four useful, evidence-based answers and, where permitted and explicitly authorized, submit them through approved accounts with appropriate brand-affiliation disclosure.
O07.assumptions: Customer expertise, approved facts and authorized accounts are available. Contributions follow each community's current rules. Shared source research and monthly reporting are reused when off-site authority or the monthly review is included. Financial-services contributions require the customer's designated review. The contribution count is a capacity limit, not an outcome.

O09.assumptions: Usable footage, approved facts, brand assets, rights and channel access are supplied by the customer. Existing question research is reused. For financial services, the customer supplies designated reviewers. Metadata and captions are included here once; YouTube answer-content optimization isn't charged again for the same launch work on this video.

FSI01.assumptions: The customer provides appropriately authorized conversation access, current source material, review criteria and named reviewers. Sampling is agreed in advance. Coworker review Skills are optional; their setup is separately scoped if selected. Shared Brand Visibility performance reporting is reused, not repeated.
